description: Store notes encrypted with real AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2 password key). Genuinely encrypted at rest.

faqs.a: Yes. Each note is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your password via PBKDF2 (100,000 SHA-256 iterations) with a random salt. Only ciphertext is stored.
No. Your password never leaves the page and is never stored. Wrong password = failed decryption, and there is no recovery.
faqs.q: What if I forget my password?

faqs.a: You can unlock the vault with the password on any device, but the encrypted notes are stored per-browser — paste the ciphertext to the other device manually.
faqs.q: Can I access notes on another device?

faqs.a: Enter your password, give the note a title, write it, and click Save Encrypted Note. Use Unlock Vault to decrypt and view.

howto: Enter a strong vault password (it is never stored).
Give the note a title and write its content.
Click Save Encrypted Note — only ciphertext is stored.
Click Unlock Vault with your password to read notes.
title: Secure Note Vault
